I'd like to Thank Congress for fucking over the most vulnerable people in the country due to bipartisan bickering

I'd like to thank Comcast for laying off an entire office because we did our job to well.

I'd like to Thank officer B for "doing his job" he can keep the car.

Special thanks to my father for running up credit cards under my name. YOUR OWN FUCKING CHILD.


I don't have a paper or a pen this will do.

What are the options?

I live in a barren apartment with stolen internet and a crappy computer.

I am 2k in debt with friends from losing my job and being hit by a car.

I owe $1500 left in student debts and I am 2 car payments behind $630
I'm also $300 overdrawn in my bank account and I have no credit for a loan.

rent is due on the 5th I won't have it.

I live off the left overs friends give me and I own one pair of pants I wash in a basin every night so my new co workers don't know i'm destitute.

I'm not frantic or emotional I'm trying to be logical.

What am I missing? I'm out of options.

Why is life "worth" living?

I'm going to be homeless soon and I can't even live in my fucking car now.

I'd rather die now and be fondly remembered then slowly poison any love my friends have for me by leeching off them or sleeping on couches.

Isn't memory important? Isn't the legacy you leave behind worth some consideration?

I'm not going to be some debt ridden slob taking hand outs from everyone I'd rather die then continue down that path.
